mapper.insert: INSERT INTO warn_notify_log (event_id, channel_type, target, content, status, deliver_state, attempt_count, send_time, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{channelType}, #{target}, #{content}, 3, 0, 0, NOW(), NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, event_id AS eventId, channel_type AS channelType, target, content, status, deliver_state AS deliverState, attempt_count AS attemptCount, next_retry_time AS nextRetryTime, fail_reason AS failReason FROM warn_notify_log WHERE deliver_state IN (0, 2) AND (next_retry_time IS NULL OR next_retry_time <= #{now}) ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, event_id AS eventId, channel_type AS channelType, target, content, status, deliver_state AS deliverState, attempt_count AS attemptCount, next_retry_time AS nextRetryTime, fail_reason AS failReason FROM warn_notify_log WHERE deliver_state IN (0, 2) AND (next_retry_time IS NULL OR next_retry_time <= #{now}) ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE warn_notify_log SET next_retry_time = #{nextRetryTime}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deliver_state IN (0, 2)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM warn_notify_log WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND deliver_state = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE warn_notify_log SET status = #{status}, deliver_state = #{deliverState}, attempt_count = #{attemptCount}, next_retry_time = #{nextRetryTime}, fail_reason = #{failReason}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deliver_state IN (0, 2)
UPDATE warn_notify_log SET status = 1, deliver_state = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deliver_state IN (0, 2)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM warn_notify_log WHERE deliver_state IN (0, 2)
SELECT MIN(next_retry_time) FROM warn_notify_log WHERE deliver_state IN (0, 2)
